name: PowOS warm Gradle builder (Mac)
purpose: powos-gradle-warm: a long-lived android-app-dev builder container whose Gradle daemon stays warm between PowOS APK builds (targets/android/build-app.sh uses it; android-app-dev's cold `make build` is the fallback and every other project's path). Idle: its Gradle daemon exits after 3 h without a build, the container ends itself after 6 h (WARM_IDLE_HOURS)
files: docker volume powos-gradle-warm (its Gradle home, seeded once from android-gradle-cache)
